preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**12 for x in map(int, stdin.split()[1:n+1]))
preconditions.description: Each vertex beauty x_v is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^12.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: The tree has exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct vertices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: is_connected(edges, n) and not has_cycle(edges, n)
preconditions.description: The edges form a connected acyclic undirected graph (a tree) rooted at vertex 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum_f(u, v) for u, v in ancestor_pairs(edges, n)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of f(u, v) for all ancestor pairs (u, v) in the tree, modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and is_ancestor(u, v, edges) for u, v in ancestor_pairs(edges, n))
postconditions.description: Every pair (u, v) in the sum is such that u is an ancestor of v in the tree rooted at 1.

postconditions.expression: all(f(u, v) == gcd([x[t] for t in path(u, v, edges)]) for u, v in ancestor_pairs(edges, n))
postconditions.description: For each ancestor pair (u, v), f(u, v) is the GCD of beauties of all vertices on the shortest path from u to v.
